requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The correct status of the record - sealed by court order, or the subject of a pardon, as the enclosed document states
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The correct status of the record - sealed by court order, or the subject of a pardon, as the enclosed document states
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the true status lives on the sealing order or pardon, which the participant obtains and the platform never inspects
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether the record is sealed by a Maine court order or is the subject of a pardon, exactly as your enclosed order or pardon states

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court that signed the sealing order, or the authority that granted the pardon
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court that signed the sealing order, or the authority that granted the pardon
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which court signed the order is a fact on a document the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court that signed the sealing order (or the pardoning authority), copied from the document

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the sealing order or of the pardon
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the sealing order or of the pardon
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no order fact is held for a document the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date the court signed the sealing order, or the date the pardon was granted, from the document itself

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Anything else about the entry that is wrong, as shown by the enclosed official record, if any
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Anything else about the entry that is wrong, as shown by the enclosed official record, if any
requiredBeforeFiling.why: accuracy against the official record is measured by the Bureau record the participant obtains, which the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: any other error - wrong person, wrong charge, wrong outcome, wrong date - as shown by your official Bureau record, or left empty where there is none

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The record exactly as the company reported it, with the charge, the case number and the disposition as printed
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The record exactly as the company reported it, with the charge, the case number and the disposition as printed
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the vendor's own printing is the thing disputed, and the platform has not seen it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the entry exactly as printed on the report - the charge, the court, the case number and the disposition

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the background-check report the record appeared on
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the background-check report the record appeared on
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no report fact is held for a document the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the report date, copied from the report

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Reference, file or confirmation number printed on the report, if any
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Reference, file or confirmation number printed on the report, if any
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no report identifier is held for a document the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the reference number, copied from the report if it shows one - it speeds the company's lookup

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Dispute mailing address published by the screening company
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Dispute mailing address published by the screening company
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the address is published by the vendor and varies, and the platform holds no address for it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the dispute address the company publishes - usually on the report itself or on the company's website; never guessed

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Screening company the letter is addressed to
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Screening company the letter is addressed to
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which company reported the record is a fact on a report the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the background-check company that reported the record, from the report itself

protectedBlanks.label: Signature on the dispute letter
protectedBlanks.why: the letter is the participant's own communication to a private company and is signed when actually sent

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the signature on the letter
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the letter is actually sent would be false
